messages:
Alex K: Uploaded pen test evidence bundle: https://redwood-secure.s3.amazonaws.com/pt/1845006789/evidence.zip. Quick summary in the README inside.
Maria G: forwarding to the customer's risk team. They need a remediation ETA + verification steps per finding.
Danielle R: I'll fix the embed-worker dependency (bump + tests). ETA 72h. I'll also remove the permissive internal S3 ACL now.
Sam D: once the PR is up I'll run perf on staging dedicated. Share the commit SHA so I can pull it. If p95 regresses we'll pause canary.
SecOps Bot: Static scan (2026-03-22T08:05:16Z) for branch fixes/pt returned 2 high, 3 medium. Report stored at s3://redwood-secops-scans/1845006789/report.html
Alex K: Auth session issue appears to be session token rotation gap during SSO refresh (CVSS 7.2). Danielle/PW: please provide test commands the customer can run.
Danielle R: Verification commands: `./scripts/ssotest --rotate --http` then check that previous session is rejected; `grep session-rotated logs/*`. I'll upload screenshots and test logs.
Maria G: customer also asks for CVSS mapping and a signed test plan. I'll prepare the cover note once you confirm ETAs.
Danielle R: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1301 commit 7a9d2b. Changes: bumped embed dep, added e2e for SSO rotate, removed public ACL. Test artifacts uploaded.
Sam D: ran perf: no p95 regression on hosted; dedicated shows +8% p95 for longform with --concurrency=8. I'll post raw numbers and suggest a canary with lowered concurrency.
Alex K: Good. Maria, can you tell the customer we're targeting internal retest by Fri EOD and handing off Mon?
Maria G: Yes — messaging sent. Customer replied: "Thanks, we'll aim to start verification Monday morning." I'll update once they confirm the slot. :white_check_mark:
